reels.caption:
Elon Musk keeps a BOXABL Casita as his guest house in South Texas. A whole foldable home, built in a factory and unfolded on site. Would you stay in one?

@boxabl #boxabl #casita #tinyhome #elonmusk #foldablehome

Post Malone thinks BOXABL houses are so cool. The Casita fits a full-size kitchen and bathroom into an 8.5 ft wide foldable home that ships on a trailer.

@boxabl #boxabl #postmalone #casita #foldablehome #tinyhome

Normal homes take months to build. This BOXABL Casita is built in a factory in Las Vegas and set up in hours, small enough to ship anywhere. Would you live in a foldable home?

@boxabl #boxabl #casita #foldablehome #tinyhome #modularhome

Elon Musk and the BOXABL Casita: a foldable home built on an assembly line and set up on site in under an hour. Would you get one?

@boxabl #boxabl #elonmusk #casita #foldablehome #tinyhome

BOXABL isn't just a tiny house company. The Casita set the stage for Phase 2: apartments, single family homes and townhouses.

@boxabl #boxabl #casita #modularhome #futureofhousing #foldablehome

They stacked 6 cars on a BOXABL Casita, then dropped a car on it from 50 feet. This foldable home is built different. Would you live in one?

@boxabl #boxabl #casita #foldablehome #tinyhome #fazerug

The first BOXABL Casita went to Elon Musk, and the team was under an NDA. Now it sits at Starbase in Texas, and BOXABL keeps growing with a huge waitlist and a new two-story prototype. Would you get one?

@boxabl #boxabl #elonmusk #casita #foldablehome #tinyhome

Airrack spent a night in a BOXABL Casita, a foldable home that looks small outside but feels cozy inside. Is less really more?

@boxabl #boxabl #airrack #casita #tinyhome #foldablehome

Rick Caruso on BOXABL: homes built on a factory production line outside Las Vegas, and a plan for 30,000 units to get people into homes. Could foldable homes change housing?

@boxabl #boxabl #joerogan #casita #foldablehome #modularhome
